readiamond.description: A powerful vocabulary learning tool that helps you learn and remember words through context.
readiamond.heroSubtitle: An intelligent reading companion for language learning
readiamond.heroDescription: Transform your reading into an immersive language learning journey with AI-powered vocabulary building and spaced repetition.
readiamond.learningDescription: Experience natural language acquisition through immersive reading. readiamond highlights familiar words and helps you discover new vocabulary in context.
readiamond.learningDetails: No more isolated word lists. Learn vocabulary the way your brain naturally processes language - through meaningful context and real-world usage.
readiamond.fsrsDescription: Powered by the scientifically-proven FSRS algorithm, readiamond optimizes your review schedule for maximum retention.
readiamond.fsrsDetails: Forget cramming. Our spaced repetition system ensures you review words exactly when you're about to forget them, building long-term memory efficiently.
readiamond.aiDescription: AI understands context, culture, and nuance. Get explanations for idioms, slang, and cultural references that mechanical translation misses.
readiamond.aiDetails: From Shakespeare's metaphors to modern internet slang, AI helps you grasp the true meaning behind the words.
readiamond.customDescription: Personalize every aspect of your learning experience. More languages, AI models, and customization options coming soon.
readiamond.customDetails: Dark mode, custom fonts, keyboard shortcuts, and data privacy - readiamond adapts to how you learn best.
readiamond.ctaDescription: Join thousands of language learners who are transforming their reading into vocabulary mastery.
readiamond.betaNotice: We are still in early development and testing phase. Thank you for your tolerance of bugs in the beta version.
